blogs.title: From Tokens to Stories: Why Sequence‑Level Rewards Fix RL for LLMs
blogs.description: Explain the core idea behind GSPO – moving from token‑wise importance ratios to sequence‑wise ones. Show how token‑level gradients introduce high variance, why whole‑response weighting aligns better with rewards, and use analogies like grading an essay versus individual sentences.

blogs.title: Stability Meets Scale: How GSPO Keeps Huge Language Models from Collapsing
blogs.description: Dive into the stability problems of GRPO, especially with long outputs and Mixture‑of‑Experts models. Illustrate the expert‐activation volatility issue, the old Routing Replay workaround, and how GSPO’s sequence‑level clipping naturally solves it without extra engineering.

blogs.title: The Secret Sauce of Qwen3’s Success: An Inside Look at Group Sequence Policy Optimization
blogs.description: Profile GSPO’s practical impact on the Qwen3 training pipeline. Compare training curves, efficiency gains, and benchmark performance versus GRPO. Include insights on how GSPO allows more compute to translate directly into higher accuracy.

blogs.title: Simplifying RL Infrastructure: How GSPO Lets You Reuse Inference Engines for Training
blogs.description: Explain the challenges of precision mismatches between training and inference engines. Show how GSPO’s reliance on sequence likelihood tolerates these differences, enabling easier integration of powerful inference libraries like vLLM or SGLang into the RL loop.

blogs.title: Beyond Basics: Token‑Level vs. Sequence‑Level Advantages in RL for LLMs
blogs.description: Walk through the theory comparing GRPO’s token‑level advantage calculation to GSPO’s group advantage. Highlight the new GSPO‑token variant for multi‑turn settings, discuss when fine‑grained token control is useful, and present side‑by‑side gradient equations for clarity.
